name: Mjeril Kendrik
source:
The mother of missing student Sarah. She lives in the elite Celeste Plaza complex in an apartment that once belonged to a legendary pianist.

She appears to be a woman broken by grief, clinging to any hope of finding her daughter.
She gives Sarah's phone to Neon  and helps her infiltrate the Academy.
